verification.note: CompleteStep.tsx:1-7 imports only loadFullPage and has no useRouter; grep over non-test files in app/setup finds no useRouter or router. call (only window.location.search at SetupWizard.tsx:98). CompleteStep.test.tsx:77 asserts only pushMock not called, so that negative test is vacuous; mutating line 58 to run loadFullPage before the res.ok check would still pass it. SetupWizard.test.tsx:499, :921 and :946 also assert only pushMock, though those tests also check that complete-setup was not called (498, 919, 945), and loadFullPage is reached only after that call, which partly covers them indirectly.

fullPageLoad.ts:7-9 sets window.location.href = path. All three importing test files mock it: unlock/__tests__/page.test.tsx:20-22, CompleteStep.test.tsx:6-8, SetupWizard.test.tsx:6-8. A grep for location.href or loadFullPage in test directories finds only those three files, and the glob for frontend/{e2e,tests,playwright} finds no e2e suite. So the real implementation is never run under test.

unspecified_scores.reason: Finishing setup in public mode (once per install) does a full reload of /admin instead of a client-side navigation, and the user sees at most a slightly slower page change.

After a successful finish, CompleteStep.tsx:61-62 re-enables the button before the document navigation unloads the page, so a quick second click on a slow load can POST complete-setup again, and the user may briefly see an error message before /admin loads.

specification_compliance: The finish path in CompleteStep calls loadFullPage('/admin') only after res.ok (CompleteStep.tsx:46-58), which matches the intent of reloading under the new cookie.
regression_risks: Because the negative navigation assertions check the unused pushMock, a regression that navigates on failure in CompleteStep would not be caught by CompleteStep.test.tsx:70-78.
test_coverage: The positive paths assert loadFullPageMock('/admin') (CompleteStep.test.tsx:58; SetupWizard.test.tsx:203, 502, 524, 753, 795, 834, 880, 959).
The negative paths assert only pushMock, which can never be called.
not_verified: I did not run the test suite or try the mutation described for R1; it was reasoned from source only.
I did not check the unlock/page.tsx test assertions beyond the mock setup lines 1-40.
I did not check whether the backend complete-setup endpoint is idempotent on a second POST.
